description: metadata.rs:372-373 (created), metadata.rs:432-433 (updated), and helpers.rs:107-108 (`set_error_value`) all carry the same `.expect("derive(Serialize) on plain data is infallible")` rationale string. The helper at helpers.rs:107 (already JMAP-826m.29) factored this once for SetError; the two call sites in metadata.rs that serialize the success-path object (`created_obj` and the post-update `obj`) re-inline the same justification — there is no helpers.rs analogue for them. — Idiomatic Rust factors the explanation once: `fn jmap_obj_value<O: Serialize>(o: &O) -> serde_json::Value { serde_json::to_value(o).expect("…") }` next to set_error_value, three call sites become `jmap_obj_value(&created_obj)`. The justification string lives in one place; a future contributor refactoring the expect-policy edits one location. — Engineering impact: low (the .expect is provably unreachable as the comment states). Filed for cookie-cut consistency with set_error_value, not for correctness.
